about: RescueCodec v2 conformance vectors. See spec/SPEC.md, section 'Conformance'. valid: encode(input) must give hex exactly; decode(hex) must give decoded. text: Level 2, render(decoded) must give these strings. decode_only: decode(hex) must give decoded. invalid_encode / invalid_decode: must be rejected; error codes should match. v1: decode_any(hex) must give decoded. packed_text: unpack(deflate, dict) must give text, decode(hex) must give decoded, and decode(encode(decoded)) must give decoded (compressors may make other bytes). text_dicts: SHA-256 of each text dictionary file. compact_text: encode(input) must give hex exactly, decode(hex) must give decoded, decode_words(words, 1) must give text and encode_words(text, 1) must give words exactly. word_streams: encode_words(text) must give words, decode_words(words) must give text. word_streams_invalid: decode_words(words, 1) must be rejected with error. word_dicts: SHA-256 and entry count of each word dictionary file. compact_frames (SPEC 3.7, first byte 0x02): encode_compact(text, dict) must give hex exactly (when text is given) and decode_compact(hex) must give decoded. compact_frames_invalid: decode_compact(hex) must be rejected with error; encode_compact(text) too when text is given.
